facts.text: Beginning in fall 2027, Carroll College is expanding its Pell Promise to fully cover tuition for qualifying Pell-eligible first-year and transfer students from any state.

sources.title: Pell Promise | Carroll College
sources.quote: Carroll College is expanding its Pell Promise to fully cover tuition for qualifying Pell-eligible first-time, first-year students from any state, as well as qualifying transfer students, beginning in fall 2027.
